title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing grant and scope validation to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and resource owner password credentials grant flows. The issue arises because OAuthlib does not require the client_id in the request body to match the authenticated client's client_id before validating grants and scopes. As a result, a low-privilege client can obtain tokens with higher privileges assigned to another client if the application validator authorizes based on the client_id argument passed by OAuthlib.
